title: Origins I: Emperor Pilav
offer: A girl with a radar is looking for seven Dragon Orbs. Come meet her! Grandpa always said to help people.
done: Puir cut my tail and the giant ape disappeared. I don't remember it! The others are safe. Let's ask Master Roshu to train us.

steps.reply: My radar found your grandfather's four-star orb. Keep it with you; help me find the other six!

steps.text: Follow the radar: recover two loose Dragon Orbs

steps.reply: All right, you saw through my disguise! Take my orb. I'll come along, but no more monsters!

steps.text: Follow the desert road to Pilav country

steps.reply: I thought you were easy travellers to rob. You can fight! Puir and I will guide you through the desert.
Our orb is yours if we travel together. The radar points toward Fire Mountain.

steps.text: Find the burning castle at Fire Mountain

steps.reply: My castle is trapped in flame. Master Roshu is my old teacher. Please find him at Kame House!
No fan? Then a focused wave will do. Stand back when I visit the mountain!

steps.text: Return to the Ox-Lord with Roshu’s promise
Stand clear and witness Roshu’s wave extinguish the castle fire

steps.reply: That wave put out the fire—and the castle! Here is the orb from my treasury. Pilav took the last one.
The emperor has your radar trail. Shoo, seal the courtyard!
Nobody escapes Pilav's battle walker. Not even a kid with a stick!
My machine! I still have the last orb. Into the glass prison with you!

steps.text: Recover the last orb before Pilav can wish
Escape the glass prison under the full moon

steps.reply: Gokan looked at the moon and became a Great Ape! I cut his tail while Yamcho distracted him. He's small again. Everyone is safe.
The orbs have scattered after Ulong spoiled Pilav's wish. This adventure is over, but your training is just beginning.

title: Origins II: The 21st World Tournament
offer: Krilan has come to learn too. Deliver milk, move your feet, and make honest effort before entering the tournament.
done: A fine final! Jackie Chung showed that there is always someone stronger. Keep training, and travel with a clear heart.

steps.reply: A training partner! Let's finish these deliveries before breakfast.

steps.text: Deliver three milk bottles around the island
Run the Turtle School delivery circuit (12 s)
Gather strength to shift the training rock (8 s)

steps.reply: The rock moved! We train body and spirit together. Now test your effort in the ring.

steps.text: Complete the tournament preliminaries at the registration line
Face Jackie Chung in the final
Return to Kame House after the final

steps.reply: Jackie Chung was amazing. We don't have to win every time to grow stronger. Let's keep going!

title: Origins III: The Red Ribbon Army
offer: The Red Ribbon Army is taking Dragon Orbs from villages. Follow the radar, protect the people, and stop their commanders.
done: The army has fallen. Cyborg 8 chose kindness, and Korrin taught patience. Baaba may know where the final orb is hidden.

steps.text: Defeat Colonel Silvar and free the patrol road
Rescue the snow village at Muscle Tower

steps.reply: I won't hurt innocent people. I'll help you rescue the village instead.
The villagers are free. Being strong should mean protecting them. I'll stay here to help rebuild.

steps.text: Find the sanctuary beneath Korrin Tower

steps.reply: Tau passed through here. Don't rush him. The tower's guardian can teach you how to read an opponent.

steps.text: Reach the foot of Korrin Tower
Climb through the tower approach by flying upward (10 s)

steps.reply: You chased strength so hard you forgot to watch. Follow the hand, read the breath, and move at the right moment.

steps.text: Watch Korrin quietly and learn patience (8 s)
Defeat Mercenary Tau after Korrin’s training
Defeat Commander Rudd and end the Red Ribbon operation
Bring the recovered radar records to Bulna

steps.reply: We stopped them! Baaba can find the missing orb, even when the radar can't. Let's visit her palace.

title: Origins IV: Fortuneteller Baaba
offer: No fortune without a fee! Win against my five fighters, and I shall show you the missing orb.
done: Your grandfather is proud. Take that memory with you; strength is nothing without the people you protect.

steps.text: Defeat Fangor, the first of Baaba’s five fighters
Read the dust trail and defeat the invisible Veilor
Resist Devilon’s tricks and win the fourth bout
Face Baaba’s mysterious masked fifth fighter

steps.reply: Gokan, it's me. You have good friends now. Never stop learning, and remember that tail can be a weakness.
A reunion is worth more than my fee. I can see the missing orb beyond the old village road.

steps.text: Follow Baaba’s vision to the mountain village
Recover the four-star keepsake from Baaba’s vision

steps.reply: Grandpa said he was proud of us. I'll keep this orb safe. The next tournament is waiting!

title: Origins V: The 22nd World Tournament
offer: The Crane School has arrived. Tenzo and Chaozo have tricks we have never seen, and an old enemy is back with a metal body.
done: The Crane students have chosen their own path. Victory is sweeter when a rival can become a friend.

steps.text: Stop Cyborg Tau’s revenge in the exhibition bout
Face Tenzo in the tournament final

steps.reply: I won't be an assassin. You fought fairly, even when we didn't. From now on, I choose my own way.

steps.text: Tell Roshu what the Crane students decided

steps.reply: That choice is worth more than a trophy. Rest now; your next test may not have rules or a referee.

title: Origins VI: King Piccor
offer: Tournament fighters are being hunted. Find the attacker, warn our friends, and stop King Piccor before his army spreads.
done: King Piccor has fallen, but his final act left an heir. Kamu asks you to train at the Lookout before that day comes.

steps.text: Return to the tournament grounds and find the attacker
Stop Tamburin’s attacks on the tournament fighters
Seek Korrin’s advice against King Piccor

steps.reply: I met one of his creatures on the road. I'll guard the tower while you speak to Korrin.

steps.text: Defeat Cymbel before he reaches the sanctuary

steps.reply: The Ultra Divine Water tests your resolve. It is no shortcut. Take only what your heart can endure.

steps.text: Steady your Ki after the water’s trial (12 s)

steps.reply: You're still standing! Take the road to the castle. I'll keep everyone safe behind you.

steps.text: Confront King Piccor at his castle
Return to Korrin with news of the victory

steps.reply: His heir will return. Fly above the tower when you're ready; Kamu and Mr. Pobo will prepare you.

title: Origins VII: The 23rd World Tournament
offer: Piccor’s heir is training too. Mr. Pobo will teach stillness, movement and control before you return to the tournament.
done: You have carried the lessons of childhood into a new age. Meet the grown Gokan in the Earth Plains to begin the next story.

steps.reply: A quiet heart moves without wasted effort. Begin with stillness, then let every step have a purpose.

steps.text: Practise stillness at Kamu’s Lookout (10 s)
Follow Mr. Pobo’s movement drill (12 s)
Control your breathing and Ki at the Lookout (10 s)

steps.reply: You are ready to face him. Win without hatred; the life you save may change the future.

steps.text: Face Piccor Jr. in the 23rd Tournament final

steps.reply: You won, and you still offered mercy. I won't forget this. Next time, I'll be stronger.

steps.text: Begin the adult journey in the Earth Plains

steps.reply: Those old adventures taught me why we fight. A new journey is beginning. Come talk to me when you're ready.

title: A Saiyar Arrives
offer: Something crashed out past the farm this morning. Gohin says it was a falling star, but I felt a huge power from it. Let's check it out!
done: A spaceship pod... and that power is still moving. Stay sharp!

steps.text: Ask the farmer what he saw

title: Radix
offer: That Saiyar, Radix, has taken Gokan's son. I hate the idea, but we fight him together. Don't slow me down.
done: Hmph. You held your own. Gokan is dead, but two more Saiyars are coming in a year. He'll train in the Other World, and I'll train the boy.

title: Serpent Road
offer: So you want to train with King Kae? He lives at the end of Serpent Road: a million kilometres of road. Don't fall off, or you'll land in Hell!
done: Made it to the end! King Kae's planet is just above.

steps.text: Run to the end of Serpent Road

title: King Kae's Training
offer: Ten times Earth's gravity here, kid! First catch Bubbo. Then, if you can make me laugh, I'll teach you the Kaiyoken and the Spirit Sphere.
done: Hah! Not bad! The Kaiyoken multiplies your power, but push it too far and your body breaks. The Spirit Sphere borrows energy from every living thing.

steps.text: Gather energy for the Spirit Sphere (hold Charge)

title: The Saiyars Land
offer: Nappo and Vegara are here, and they planted Saiblings! Gokan's still on his way back. We have to hold them off!
done: Yamcho... no, we got through it. But Nappo is next.

title: Nappo
offer: That brute is too strong for us alone. Hit him with everything while I prepare a Triad Beam!
done: We did it... I'll teach you the Triad Beam. Just don't burn your life force out like I nearly did.

title: Prince of the Saiyars
offer: Vegara is the real threat. If he turns into a Great Ape under the moon, we're done. Gokan's here, fight with him!
done: Vegara ran... Bulna found out he was heading for Nameck. Their Dragon Orbs could bring everyone back!

steps.text: Defeat Vegara (and survive his Great Ape form)

title: Journey to Nameck
offer: Dad built a ship from Gokan's old pod. It'll get us to Nameck. Their Dragon Orbs can revive everyone the Saiyars killed. Get in!
done: Nameck! Green sky, blue grass... and I'm picking up Frigor's soldiers on the scouter.

title: Mooru's Village
offer: Frigor's men, led by Dodorra, are burning the villages for the Dragon Orbs. Please, protect my people and the boy Dendo.
done: You saved us. Dendo will take you to the Grand Elder. He can draw out the strength sleeping in you.

steps.text: Drive off Dodorra and his soldiers

title: The Grand Elder
offer: Grand Elder Gura lives on the tallest pillar. Fly up with me. He can unlock your hidden potential!
done: Hmm... great power slept inside you. It is awake now. Use it to protect Nameck.

title: The Nameckian Dragon Orbs
offer: The radar shows three Nameckian Dragon Orbs nearby. Grab them before Vegara or Frigor does! And watch out for Zarvon.
done: We have them! Now we just need the password... and to survive the Ginnu Force.

title: The Ginnu Force
offer: Frigor called his elite Ginnu Force. Rekume, Burtor, Jayce, Guldor and Ginnu himself. Don't get in my way, and don't let Ginnu swap bodies with you.
done: Ginnu is a frog now. Kakarro... is a Super Saiyar? No. Not yet. But Frigor is coming.

steps.text: Defeat Burtor, the fastest in the universe

title: Frigor
offer: Frigor has come for the Grand Elder. I will hold him as long as I can. Gather your strength and face him with Gokan.
done: Krilan... Frigor killed him, and Gokan snapped. A golden warrior... a Super Saiyar. Nameck is about to explode. Get to the ship!

steps.text: Survive Frigor's transformations and defeat him
Escape to the Kapsule Corp ship before Nameck explodes

title: Instant Transfer
offer: You fell from the sky like the other Saiyar. We Yardrats teach a way to move: feel a ki far away, and be there. Calm your spirit first.
done: You can now lock onto any ki you have felt and arrive in an instant. Travel pads in every world will take you anywhere you have been.

steps.text: Show the Elder what you learned

title: The Boy from the Future
offer: Frigor survived. He and his father King Kold are landing near West Capital. I came from the future to stop them, and to warn you about the Cyborgs.
done: In three years two Cyborgs will destroy everything. Please, get stronger. I'll wait for you in the northern mountains.

title: Cyborgs 19 and 20
offer: These Cyborgs absorb ki through their hands. Don't fire blasts at them. Break them up close. Dr. Gerro is Cyborg 20. Follow him to his lab!
done: He opened the capsules before we could stop him. 17 and 18 are awake.

steps.text: Chase Dr. Gerro to his lab

title: 17, 18 and 16
offer: Cyborgs 17 and 18 are stronger than anything Tronks warned us about. And there's a third one, 16, who won't fight unless it's Gokan.
done: They let us live... and left with 16 to find Gokan. Something else is out there, too. A shell, in Ginger Town.

title: Imperfect Cel
offer: Another time machine, and an empty shell next to it. A creature made from all of your cells came from another future. It's in Ginger Town, draining people.
done: Piccor has fused with Kamu to fight it. Cel escaped to absorb the Cyborgs... we need to train faster than time allows.

steps.text: Fight Imperfect Cel in Ginger Town

title: The Hyperbolic Time Room
offer: A year inside the Room of Spirit and Time is a single day outside. The air is thin, it is ten times heavier, and it gets very hot and very cold. Do not stay too long.
done: You have done a year of training. You are a different fighter now.

steps.text: Train for a 'year' under 10x gravity (keep moving)
Push your ki past its limit (hold Charge)

title: Perfect Cel
offer: Cel absorbed 17 and 18 and became perfect. Now he's holding a tournament: the Cel Games. Father says I'm the one who has to win it.
done: Cel made seven little copies of himself... he wants to watch us suffer.

steps.text: Go to the Cel Games arena
Face Perfect Cel in the ring

title: The Cel Games
offer: Cyborg 16 is gone... I can't hold it back anymore. Help me with the Cel Juniors, then we finish this with one last Kamehamera!
done: It's over. Cel is gone. Mr. Sadan is taking the credit, and honestly, let him.

steps.text: Beam struggle! Pour your ki into the Kamehamera (hold Charge)

title: The Grand Martial Arts Tournament
offer: Welcome to the 25th Grand Martial Arts Tournament! Show us your power on the punching machine to qualify!
done: Two strangers in Kae robes are watching the fighters. And Spopovik just broke the punching machine...

steps.text: Talk to the strange man in the crowd

title: Babido's Spaceship
offer: I am the Supreme Kae. A wizard named Babido is gathering energy to revive Majinn Boo. Spopovik drained Gohin for him. We must stop Babido's minions: Poi Poi, Yakkon and Dabora.
done: Babido got into Vegara's heart. Vegara let himself be controlled... and released enough energy to wake Boo.

steps.text: Defeat Dabora, King of the Demon Realm

title: Majinn Boo
offer: Papapara! Majinn Boo is awake! Go on, Boo, destroy them all!
done: Vegara gave his life and Boo still pulled himself back together. The Supreme Kae says there is a sword in his world that can save us.

steps.text: At the Lookout, learn the Fusion Step with Gotin and Tronks

title: The Z Sword
offer: Legend says whoever pulls the Z Sword from its stone gains incredible power. Gohin is trying. Go and see.
done: The sword broke... and an Old Kae was sealed inside! He says he can draw out your full potential, if you can sit still for it.

steps.text: Sit through Old Kae's unlocking ritual (stand still near him)

title: Kid Boo and the Spirit Sphere
offer: Boo absorbed everyone and split into his pure form, Kid Boo. He's on the Sacred World now. Everyone on Earth is lending their energy. Raise your hands!
done: ...we did it. Boo is gone. Maybe someday he'll be reborn as a good guy. I'd like to fight him again!

steps.text: Go to the Sacred World of the Kae
Charge the Spirit Sphere with the whole Earth (hold Charge)

title: The God of Destruction
offer: Mmm, this pudding is delicious. I'm looking for a 'Super Saiyar God'. If I'm not entertained, I'll destroy the Earth. No pressure.
done: Not bad at all. I'll let the Earth live. Wiss, take the Saiyars' little friend to our planet. They should learn what real training is.

steps.text: Help Bulna calm everyone down at the party

title: Training with Wiss
offer: Ohoho, welcome. First, there is no wasted motion in my training. Calm your mind, keep your ki steady. Let us begin.
done: Very good. Your ki no longer leaks. By the way, a certain Frigor is coming back to Earth. I thought you should know.

steps.text: Run Wiss's laps around the temple
Hold your ki perfectly still (hold Charge)

title: Resurrection 'F'
offer: Frigor's back! Sorbel revived him with the Dragon Orbs, and he trained for four months! His army is landing out here!
done: Golden Frigor... and he still lost. Too bad he got so cocky.

steps.text: Stop Sorbel and the Frigor Force

title: Champo's Tournament
offer: Brother Beeros thinks his universe is better than mine. Five fighters each, winner takes the Super Dragon Orbs! Let's see your team!
done: Hmph! Next time, Beeros! Next time!

steps.text: Push Botama out of the ring
Defeat Frosk (watch for his poison needle)

title: Gokan Black
offer: Something with Gokan's face is destroying my future, calling it 'justice'. The time machine has just enough energy for one more trip. Please, come with me.
done: Black is Zamazu. A Kae who stole Gokan's body with the Super Dragon Orbs. And there's a second Zamazu... immortal.

steps.text: Take the time machine to Future Earth
Meet Mae at the resistance hideout

title: Merged Zamazu
offer: Black and Zamazu fused with the Potaro. Mom's notes mention the Evil Containment Wave... and everyone's hope. Lend me your energy!
done: Zenno erased this timeline to stop Zamazu... Mae and I will live in another one. Thank you. All of you.

steps.text: Lend your energy to Tronks's Sword of Hope (hold Charge)

title: The Tournament of Might
offer: Eight universes, ten fighters each, forty-eight minutes. Anyone who falls off the stage is eliminated. The losing universes will be erased by Grand Zenno. Begin!
done: Universe 7 wins. Cyborg 17 wished every erased universe back. Grand Zenno enjoyed himself very much.

steps.text: Defeat Toppa, God of Destruction candidate
Find Ultra Intuition: stay calm in the centre (stand still)

title: Brolo
offer: Frigor brought a Saiyar called Brolo here to fight. He's not evil, just... his father Paragos controls him. Please don't kill him.
done: We wished Brolo away to his old planet. Gokan says he'll visit and teach him. And Frigor... ran away again.

steps.text: Withstand Brolo's Legendary Super Saiyar rage
Help Chelai with the Dragon Orb wish

title: Morro: The Escaped Prisoner

steps.text: Travel with the Star Patrol to New Nameck
Drive Morro away from New Nameck

offer: Morro: The Escaped Prisoner. Follow the objective and help the others stop this threat.
done: Morro: The Escaped Prisoner complete. Prepare for the next stage.

title: Defend Earth with the Star Patrol
offer: Defend Earth with the Star Patrol. Follow the objective and help the others stop this threat.
done: Defend Earth with the Star Patrol complete. Prepare for the next stage.

title: Morro: Perfected Resolve

steps.text: Stop Morro after his copied angel power
Focus your energy to finish the battle

offer: Morro: Perfected Resolve. Follow the objective and help the others stop this threat.
done: Morro: Perfected Resolve complete. Prepare for the next stage.

title: Granolo: The Survivor

steps.text: Face Granolo and his precision attacks
Hear Monaido’s account of the past

offer: Granolo: The Survivor. Follow the objective and help the others stop this threat.
done: Granolo: The Survivor complete. Prepare for the next stage.

title: Bardak’s Resolve

steps.text: Learn how Bardak protected the survivors

offer: Bardak’s Resolve. Follow the objective and help the others stop this threat.
done: Bardak’s Resolve complete. Prepare for the next stage.

title: Gaz: The Strongest Wish
offer: Gaz: The Strongest Wish. Follow the objective and help the others stop this threat.
done: Gaz: The Strongest Wish complete. Prepare for the next stage.

title: The Arrival of Black Frigor

steps.text: Recover and prepare for what comes next

offer: The Arrival of Black Frigor. Follow the objective and help the others stop this threat.
done: The Arrival of Black Frigor complete. Prepare for the next stage.

title: Super Hero
offer: The Crimson Ribbon Army is back, with two androids who think they're heroes, and they're working on Cel Max. They kidnapped Panna. Gohin's on his way. We're going in.
done: Gama 2 gave his life for us. Gohin reached a new level: Beast. Next time I'm not losing to these kids.

title: The Kamehamera
offer: You want to learn the Kamehamera? It took me fifty years! Deliver my milk around the island first, then focus your ki in your hands.
done: Kamehame... HA! Very good. Turtle School is proud of you.

steps.text: Deliver milk to the north shore
Deliver milk to the west shore
Gather ki in your palms (hold Charge)

title: Krilan's Sparring
offer: Spar with me! Run the beach until you can't feel your legs. I'll show you my Destro Disc after.
done: Careful with that disc, it cuts through anything. Even you!

title: Survival Training
offer: Gohin survived six months alone in the wild. Prove you can do the same. Stay out in the plains, keep moving, and don't come crying to me.
done: ...Fine. You're not useless. Spiral Beam Cannon. Watch closely.

steps.text: Survive in the wild plains (keep moving, away from spawn)

title: The Farmer's Shotgun
offer: That weirdo with the hair caught my bullet with two fingers! My truck rolled into the field. Push it back for me? It's out by the big rock.
done: Thank ye kindly. Here, take some zeni for your trouble.

title: Princess Serpa's Palace
offer: Visitors on Serpent Road are so rare! Stay for a meal? No? Then at least run me some flowers from the far end of the road.
done: How sweet. Do come back!

steps.text: Pick flowers further down Serpent Road

title: Gravity Training (repeatable)
offer: Back for more? Ten times gravity, one minute, keep moving!
done: Your body is getting used to it. Come back any time!

title: Another Year Inside (repeatable)
offer: One more 'year'? Mr. Pobo will keep the door open.
done: You are getting stronger. Mr. Pobo is impressed.

steps.text: Train in the Time Chamber (keep moving)

title: Wiss's Laps (repeatable)
offer: Shall we go again? Without wasted motion, please.
done: Lovely. Now, is there any more of that ramen?

title: The Dragon Radar
offer: My Dragon Radar shows all seven of Earth's Dragon Orbs scattered across the planet. Gather them and summon Shenra at Kamu's Lookout!
done: SHENRON: Speak your wish. ... It shall be granted. Your power grows!

steps.text: Summon Shenra at the Lookout and make a wish

title: Ajisa Saplings
offer: Frigor's soldiers burned our Ajisa trees. Plant new saplings on the islands to the east and west.
done: Nameck will grow green again. Thank you, friend.

steps.text: Plant saplings on the east island
Plant saplings on the west island

title: Warrior of Nameck
offer: I am Gura's guardian. Fight beside me against Frigor's scouts on the far islands. A Nameckian warrior must know the Bursting Demon Wave.
done: You fight with honour.

steps.text: Defeat Frigor's scouts on the south-east island

title: Wolf Claw Fist
offer: Hey, don't laugh, I was a desert bandit once! Run the streets of West Capital with me and I'll teach you the Wolf Claw Fist.
done: Wolf Claw Fist! See? Still got it.

title: Saiyar Pride
offer: You call yourself a Saiyar? Train in Bulna's gravity room until you can't stand, then we'll talk about the Galik Blaster.
done: Hmph. Galik Blaster. And the Big Burst Attack. Don't embarrass our race.

steps.text: Train in the gravity room at Kapsule Corp

title: Frigor Force Deserter
offer: You're one of Frigor's kind, huh? There's a deserter from his army hiding on the west island. He says he'll teach you if you get him off the planet.
done: Doom Beam. Doom Orb. Use them better than Frigor ever did.

steps.text: Find the deserter on the west island

title: Majinn Sweets
offer: You're Majinn like Boo! Boo make candy! You make candy too! Hold your magic, like this!
done: Sweet Beam! Yummy. Boo share with Mister Satan.

steps.text: Gather Majinn magic with Boo (hold Charge)

title: Hakaido
offer: Destruction is the other half of creation. I'll show you the basics of Hakaido, if you can keep up with Wiss for once.
done: Don't go destroying planets. That's my job.

title: The Oracle Fish
offer: Blub. I see the future, blub. Bring Lord Beeros a pudding from Earth and I'll tell you a prophecy.
done: Blub. A Saiyar will become a god. Possibly several. Blub.

steps.text: Buy a pudding at Kapsule Corp

title: Kabba's Super Saiyar
offer: Master Vegara said anger unlocks the Super Saiyar. Will you spar with me? I want to protect my planet Sadala.
done: Thank you! Universe 6's Saiyars will grow strong too.

title: Supplies for the Resistance
offer: We're out of food and capsules. Search the ruins for supply crates.
done: This will keep us alive another month.

steps.text: Find 4 supply crates in the ruins

title: Recruit Universe 7
offer: We need ten fighters! I've got Vegara, 17 and... Frigor. Yeah, I know. Go say hi to the team so we're ready!
done: Ten fighters! Let's go!

title: Chelai's Escape
offer: Me and Chelai are done with Frigor. Help us grab supplies from his ship and we'll go live with Brolo.
done: Thanks. Look after yourself.

title: Babysitting Panna
offer: Mister Piccor flies me to kindergarten! Can you fly with me too? Let's fly fly fly!
done: Again! Again!

title: The Legendary Super Saiyar
offer: On Nameck I got angry enough to break through. You can too. Feel your limit and push past it.
done: Golden hair, green eyes. You're a Super Saiyar!

title: Super Saiyar 2
offer: When 16 died, something snapped in me. Lightning, all around. You've got it in you too.
done: That's it! Super Saiyar 2!

steps.text: Find the rage in the Cel Games ring (hold Charge)

title: Super Saiyar 3
offer: In the Other World I found a third level. It eats ki like crazy, but your hair gets really long!
done: Super Saiyar 3! Don't hold it too long.

steps.text: Hold your power under 10x gravity (hold Charge)

title: Super Saiyar God
offer: A Super Saiyar God is born when five righteous Saiyars pour their energy into a sixth. Find them in West Capital.
done: Red hair, calm ki. The power of a god.

title: Super Saiyar Blue
offer: God ki with a Super Saiyar's body. Perfect control is required. Again, no wasted motion.
done: Super Saiyar God Super Saiyar. Or 'Blue', if you prefer.

steps.text: Master god ki under Wiss (hold Charge)

title: Super Saiyar (Half-Saiyar)
offer: Gokan and Gohin stayed in Super Saiyar for a whole year in here, to make it feel natural. You should do the same.
done: Mr. Pobo sees golden hair.

steps.text: Stay at full power in the Time Chamber (hold Charge)

title: Super Saiyar 2 (Half-Saiyar)
offer: Your hidden power is like mine. Let it out, the way I did against Cel.
done: Super Saiyar 2! You're like me!

steps.text: Let the anger out in the ring (hold Charge)

title: Super Saiyar Rage
offer: When I saw what Black did to my world, my anger and everyone's hope became one power. Find yours.
done: Super Saiyar Rage. Use it to protect people.

steps.text: Feel the ruined world's rage (hold Charge)

title: Ultimate
offer: Your potential is like the boy Gohin's. Sit. Hours of ritual, then everything you could ever be. No transformation, just you.
done: There. Your full potential, and no ki drain to speak of.

steps.text: Sit through the ritual (stand still near Old Kae)

title: Beast
offer: When Gohin saw me 'die' against Cel Max, he went beyond anything. Silver hair, red eyes. You have that in you.
done: Beast. Even Gokan would be jealous.

steps.text: Release your potential under Gohin’s guidance

title: Kaiyoken
offer: Kaiyoken is a technique for humans and Saiyars alike. Train your body to withstand the strain.
done: Kaiyoken! Red aura and everything!

steps.text: Hold the Kaiyoken under 10x gravity (hold Charge)

title: Kaiyoken x10
offer: Times ten. It nearly tore Gokan apart against Vegara. Are you sure? ...Of course you are.
done: Kaiyoken times TEN! Ow, ow, ow.

steps.text: Push to Kaiyoken x10 where Gokan fought Vegara (hold Charge)

title: Potential Unleashed
offer: Humans have more hidden potential than they know. Sit still, and I will draw all of it out.
done: Potential Unleashed. A human with the calm of a Kae.

steps.text: Sit through the ritual (stand still near Old Kae)

title: Fusion with Nael
offer: I am dying. Put your hand on my chest. My power will live on in you, as one Nameckian.
done: Nael's power is part of you now.

steps.text: Fuse with Nael (stand still beside him)

title: Giant Form
offer: Nameckian warriors can grow to enormous size. Breathe in, and keep breathing.
done: A giant of Nameck!

steps.text: Grow on the open island (hold Charge)

title: Orange Piccor
offer: Shenra unlocked my potential and gave me a new form. Let's see if a fellow Nameckian can reach it.
done: Orange! ...It's a good colour. Don't say anything.

title: Final Form
offer: Your kind hides power in smaller bodies. Frigor transformed three times before he showed his true form. Shed your shell.
done: Smooth, white and terrifying. Your final form.

title: 100% Full Power
offer: Frigor needed a minute to reach 100%. Muscles, veins, the works.
done: 100% Full Power.

title: Golden
offer: Frigor trained for only four months and turned gold. Imagine what you could do with real effort.
done: Golden. Do watch your stamina.

steps.text: Train like Frigor did for four months (keep moving)

title: Black
offer: Frigor spent ten years in here and came out black. Mr. Pobo has the door open.
done: Mr. Pobo is a little scared.

steps.text: Ten years in the Time Chamber (keep moving)

title: Super Majinn
offer: You carry Majinn magic, like Boo. Bibido's magic grows stronger by taking in power. Absorb what Babido left behind in his ship, before it fades.
done: Super Majinn. Please use it more kindly than Boo did.

steps.text: Absorb the magic left in Babido's ship (hold Charge)

title: Kid Form
offer: Kid Boo was Majinn Boo's purest, most chaotic form. Strip away everything you absorbed.
done: Small, fast and unpredictable. Please don't destroy anything.

title: Pure Majinn
offer: Majinn magic without any evil left in it. That is what the Grand Supreme Kae's goodness became inside Boo.
done: Pure Majinn. Gentle and terrifying at once.

steps.text: Meditate at the Kae crystals (stand still)

title: Ohzaru (Great Ape)
offer: Learn to control the Great Ape power in your Saiyar heritage.
done: Unlocked Ohzaru (Great Ape).

title: False Super Saiyar
offer: Push toward the Super Saiyar threshold.
done: Unlocked False Super Saiyar.

steps.text: Train to unlock False Super Saiyar

title: Legendary Super Saiyar (Brolo)
offer: Train with Brolo to contain the Legendary Super Saiyar’s overflowing power.
done: Unlocked Legendary Super Saiyar (Brolo).

steps.text: Train to unlock Legendary Super Saiyar (Brolo)

title: Super Saiyar Grade 2 (Super Vegara)
offer: This form evolves automatically through mastery.
done: Unlocked Super Saiyar Grade 2 (Super Vegara).

steps.text: Train to unlock Super Saiyar Grade 2 (Super Vegara)

title: Super Saiyar Grade 3 (Super Tronks)
offer: This form evolves automatically through mastery.
done: Unlocked Super Saiyar Grade 3 (Super Tronks).

steps.text: Train to unlock Super Saiyar Grade 3 (Super Tronks)

title: Full Power Super Saiyar
offer: This form evolves automatically through mastery.
done: Unlocked Full Power Super Saiyar.

steps.text: Train to unlock Full Power Super Saiyar

title: Golden Ohzaru
offer: This form evolves automatically through mastery.
done: Unlocked Golden Ohzaru.

title: Super Saiyar 4
offer: This form evolves automatically through mastery.
done: Unlocked Super Saiyar 4.

title: Ultra Intuition -Sign- (Form)
offer: Revisit the Tournament of Might breakthrough: separate the transformation from the weaker focus technique.
done: Unlocked Ultra Intuition -Sign- (Form).

title: Perfected Ultra Intuition
offer: Quiet your mind and complete the silver-haired transformation.
done: Unlocked Perfected Ultra Intuition.

steps.text: Train to unlock Perfected Ultra Intuition

title: Meros: Ultra Intuition Mastery
offer: Meros teaches you to sustain perfected Ultra Intuition after the Morro battle.
done: Your control is stable. Mastery reduces the form’s ki drain.

title: Ultra Intuition: Energy Avatar
offer: Hold your perfected instinct and project its energy beyond your body. The giant Avatar is a technique, not another transformation.
done: Your energy Avatar can now be equipped from Techniques. Use it while in Perfected or True Ultra Intuition.

steps.text: Channel the Avatar in Perfected or True Ultra Intuition (hold Charge)

title: True Ultra Intuition
offer: Find your own emotional, black-haired Ultra Intuition while facing the legacy of the Gaz battle.
done: Unlocked True Ultra Intuition.

steps.text: Train to unlock True Ultra Intuition

title: Ultra Self
offer: Train in Destruction with Beeros and follow Vegara’s Ultra Self path.
done: Unlocked Ultra Self.

title: Seven Orbs of Nameck
offer: Seven Nameckian Dragon Orbs, seven islands. Find the full set and Dendo will help you summon Porunda for three wishes.
done: Your three wishes are granted. Your strength is restored and your training potential grows.

steps.text: Ask Porunda to restore your strength
steps.reply: Wish 1 of 3: it shall be granted.
Wish 2 of 3: it shall be granted.
Wish 3 of 3: it shall be granted.

title: Super Dragon Orbs: The Golden Dragon
offer: The Super Dragon Orbs are planet-sized. Survey seven cosmic retrieval beacons across the divine and tournament worlds; we will assemble the real orbs in space and call the golden Super Shenra. This hunt opens after the Universe 6 tournament.
done: Your wish is granted. Your strength is restored and your training potential grows.

steps.text: Survey all 7 Super Dragon Orb retrieval beacons
Ask the golden Super Shenra to restore your strength and expand your potential
steps.reply: Wish 1 of 1: it shall be granted.

title: Grain: The Two Dragon Orbs
offer: These are the two small Cerealian Dragon Orbs used in the wishes that empowered Granolo and Gaz. Recover both and I will help you call Toronba. Ask for your own potential, rather than trading away your life.
done: Your wish is granted. Your strength is restored and your training potential grows.

steps.text: Ask Toronba to unlock training potential without sacrificing your lifespan
steps.reply: Wish 1 of 1: it shall be granted.

title: Training Plains: Patrol
offer: Defeat 3 hostile trainees near camp. Practice your melee combo, guard and ki attacks. Return for another contract whenever you need XP and zeni.
done: Good work! Spend your stat points, learn techniques from story trainers, and take another contract when you are ready.
